lines.3: For an athlete, she sure could drag out a lecture.
lines.9: 「I'd never let anyone see me like that before.」
lines.10: 「Don't worry. We can just agree that one didn't count.」
lines.11: 「Don't say that with such a breezy smile, you idiot!」
lines.13: If I said something, she kicked me.
lines.14: If I kept quiet, she hit me.
lines.15: What was I supposed to do?
lines.16: 「I'm only letting you off this lightly because it's you.」
lines.17: 「What do you think I'd have done if you were some stranger breaking in?」
lines.19: 「Then I'd slam you to the floor, roll you onto your back, and break your ribs.」
lines.20: 「Of course, I'd crush your groin with a kick, too.」
lines.21: 「Compared to that, you... You should be grateful!」
